user.title: Glowmarkt (Bright)
user.description: Sign in with the account you use for the Bright app. Your smart meter must already be set up and verified in Bright.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Glowmarkt
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer working. Enter it again to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Glowmarkt API. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Those credentials were rejected. Use the same email and password as the Bright app.
error.no_meters: Signed in successfully, but no meters were found on this account. Complete meter setup in the Bright app first.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Glowmarkt account is already set up.

init.title: Glowmarkt options
init.description: How far back to reach the first time statistics are imported. Existing statistics are never re-fetched, so raising this later only pulls in the extra history.
